seedance_2_5.name: Seedance 2.5
seedance_2_5.description: Seedance 2.5 text-to-video, multimodal omni-reference generation, video edit, and video extension

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Generation mode: 't2v' for prompt-only generation, 'omni_reference' for image, video, or audio references, 'video_edit' to edit one reference video (billed by that video's duration; 'duration' and 'aspect_ratio' are ignored), or 'video_extension' to extend a reference video ('aspect_ratio' is ignored — the output follows the extended video).

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Duration in seconds (4-30). Whole number.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Output resolution: 480p, 720p, or 1080p.

parameters.name: generate_audio
parameters.description: Generate audio for the output video.

parameters.name: bitrate_mode
parameters.description: 'standard' = normal output bitrate; 'high' = higher bitrate output.

parameters.name: extension_mode
parameters.description: Extension direction; required for mode 'video_extension' and not allowed otherwise.

parameters.name: draft
parameters.description: Generate a 480p draft that can be finalized within seven days.

parameters.name: draft_job_id
parameters.description: Completed draft job to finalize at 1080p.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Output resolution: 480p, 720p, or 1080p.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Duration in seconds (4-30). Whole number.

parameters.name: resolution

parameters.name: generate_audio

parameters.name: bitrate_mode

parameters.name: era_id
parameters.description: Cinema Studio 4.0 creative-control id selecting the film era.

parameters.name: camera_model_id

parameters.name: camera_lens_id

parameters.name: light
parameters.description: Lighting source: 'preset' for a Cinema Studio scheme, 'user' for the caller's saved lighting preset, or 'custom' for a placed rig.

parameters.name: light_id
parameters.description: Lighting id. Use a Cinema Studio control id with light='preset', a saved lighting-preset id with light='user', or 'custom' for a placed rig.

parameters.name: light_custom
parameters.description: Ordered custom lighting rig. The first source is the key light. Each item is an object {direction: top|bottom|left|right|front|back|top-left|top-right|bottom-left|bottom-right|front-top|front-bottom|front-left|front-right|back-top|back-bottom|back-left|back-right|front-top-left|front-top-right|front-bottom-left|front-bottom-right|back-top-left|back-top-right|back-bottom-left|back-bottom-right (required), color: string, brightness: integer, diffuse: integer}.

parameters.name: color_palette
parameters.description: Color palette selection with type 'preset' or 'user' and its id.
